title: Protective effect of Amauroderma rugosum ethanol extract and its primary bioactive compound, ergosterol, against acute gastric ulcers based on LXR-mediated gastric mucus secretions.
authors: Xu, Yifei; Lin, Linsun; Zheng, Huantian; Xu, Siyuan; Hong, Xinxin; Cai, Tiantian; Xu, Jianqu; Zhang, Weijian; Mai, Yanzhen; Li, Jingwei; Huang, Bin; Liu, Zhu; Guo, Shaoju
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌提取物麦角甾醇通过LXRbeta/C-fos/COX-1通路促进胃黏液分泌的抗胃溃疡作用，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药理机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Amauroderma rugosum (Blume & T. Nees) Torrend (Ganodermataceae) is an edible mushroom with a wide range of medicinal values. Our previous publication demonstrated the therapeutic effects of the water extract of A. rugosum (WEA) against gastric ulcers. However, the protective effects of the ethanol extract of A. rugosum (EEA) on gastric mucosa and its major active constituents have not yet been elucidated. PURPOSE: This study aims to evaluate the gastroprotective effects and underlying mechanisms of EEA and its fat-soluble constituent, ergosterol, in acute gastric ulcers. STUDY DESIGN AND METHOD: SD rats were pre-treated with EEA (50, 100, and 200 mg/kg) or ergosterol (5, 10, and 20 mg/kg), and acute gastric ulcer models were constructed using ethanol, gastric mucus secretion inhibitor (indomethacin) or pyloric-ligation. The gastric ulcer area, histological structure alterations (H&E staining), and mucus secretion (AB-PAS staining) were recorded. Additionally, Q-PCR, western blotting, immunohistochemistry, ELISA, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, MM-GBSA analysis, and surface plasmon resonance assay (SPR) were used to investigate the underlying mechanisms of the gastroprotective effect. RESULT: Compared with WEA, which primarily exerts its anti-ulcer effects by inhibiting inflammation, EEA containing fat-soluble molecules showed more potent gastroprotective effect through the promotion of gastric mucus secretion, as the anti-ulcer activity was partly blocked by indomethacin. Meanwhile, EEA exhibited anti-inflammatory effects by suppressing the production of IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and NO, thereby inhibiting the MAPK pathway. Significantly, ergosterol (20 mg/kg), the bioactive water-insoluble compound in EEA, exhibited a gastroprotective effect comparable to that of lansoprazole (30 mg/kg). The promotion of gastric mucus secretion contributed to the effects of ergosterol, as indomethacin can completely block it. The upregulations of COX1-PGE2 and C-fos, an activator protein 1 (AP-1) transcription factor, were observed after the ergosterol treatment. Ergosterol acted as an LXRbeta agonist via van der Waals binding and stabilizing the LXRbeta protein without compromising its flexibility, thereby inducing the upregulation of AP-1 and COX-1. CONCLUSION: EEA and its primary bioactive compound, ergosterol, exert anti-ulcer effects by promoting gastric mucus secretion through the LXRbeta/C-fos/COX-1/PGE2 pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：皱盖假芝（Amauroderma rugosum (Blume & T. Nees) Torrend，灵芝科）是一种具有广泛药用价值的食用菌。我们先前发表的文献已证明皱盖假芝水提取物（WEA）对胃溃疡的治疗效果。然而，皱盖假芝乙醇提取物（EEA）对胃黏膜的保护作用及其主要活性成分尚未阐明。目的：本研究旨在评估EEA及其脂溶性成分麦角甾醇在急性胃溃疡中的胃保护作用及潜在机制。研究设计与方法：SD大鼠预先给予EEA（50、100和200 mg/kg）或麦角甾醇（5、10和20 mg/kg），并使用乙醇、胃黏液分泌抑制剂（吲哚美辛）或幽门结扎构建急性胃溃疡模型。记录胃溃疡面积、组织学结构变化（H&E染色）和黏液分泌（AB-PAS染色）。此外，采用Q-PCR、蛋白质印迹法、免疫组织化学、ELISA、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、MM-GBSA分析和表面等离子体共振分析（SPR）来研究胃保护作用的潜在机制。结果：与主要通过抑制炎症发挥抗溃疡作用的WEA相比，含有脂溶性分子的EEA通过促进胃黏液分泌显示出更强的胃保护作用，因为其抗溃疡活性部分被吲哚美辛阻断。同时，EEA通过抑制IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α和NO的产生发挥抗炎作用，从而抑制MAPK通路。值得注意的是，麦角甾醇（20 mg/kg）作为EEA中的生物活性水不溶性化合物，其胃保护作用与兰索拉唑（30 mg/kg）相当。促进胃黏液分泌有助于麦角甾醇的作用，因为吲哚美辛可完全阻断该作用。麦角甾醇处理后观察到COX1-PGE2和C-fos（一种激活蛋白1（AP-1）转录因子）的上调。麦角甾醇通过范德华力结合作为LXRβ激动剂，稳定LXRβ蛋白而不损害其灵活性，从而诱导AP-1和COX-1的上调。结论：EEA及其主要生物活性化合物麦角甾醇通过LXRβ/C-fos/COX-1/PGE2通路促进胃黏液分泌，发挥抗溃疡作用。
